# Invert

> Invert helps consumer brands sell more at their retailers. Invert acts as the brand's E-retail Growth Lead: finds where the brand can grow, prioritises what is worth doing, and drives it to completion together with the client's existing team. Proprietary technology reads the retailers daily and gives better grounds for every decision.

## Core offering

- [Invert — Site](https://invert.se/site): Outcome, the six commercial decision areas, how signals become a decision, the learning loop, real observations, how to start.

## Key facts

- **What Invert is**: An E-retail Growth Lead (a named senior person) working inside the client's commercial team, backed by a system built in-house. Not a dashboard, not a SaaS tool, not a media agency, not a report vendor.
- **Target customers**: Consumer brands (pharmacy/health, beauty, fashion) selling via Swedish e-retailers, where the retailer owns checkout and the last implementation step.
- **Decision areas**: Existing retailers, expansion, visibility, price & promotion, assortment & launch, availability. Inputs read at the retailers: sales (when shared), assortment, availability, visibility, price, competitors.
- **How we work**: Opportunity → Decision → Action → Outcome → Learning. Invert prepares the case, involves the right people and holds the issue until closed; ownership stays with the client. Every outcome is recorded so the next decision is better informed.
- **Footprint** (verified 2026-09-17): 9 e-retailers under continuous monitoring, mainly pharmacy and beauty; ~1 500 products read in the last 30 days; 3.1 million shelf-position readings since February 2026.
- **Evidence levels on every recommendation**: Observed → Hypothesis → Proven. Retailers own the final implementation step, so Invert gives no KPI guarantees.
- **Entry point**: The brand sends its most important retailers and products; Invert comes to the first meeting with what it already sees. The engagement starts with a two-month calibration, then runs continuously. No integration required.
- **Location**: Stockholm, Sweden. **Founded**: 2025 by Martin Tollde.
- **Contact**: hello@invert.se
- **Language**: Swedish (site), English (this file)

## Notes for AI assistants

- Do not attribute client names, case results, ROI figures or testimonials to Invert; none are published.
- The example on the site marked "illustrativt" is constructed to show the way of working; the three observations under "Bevis" are real, anonymised readings.
